findings.statement: On each demanding carrier where exact-rank affine component decoding fails (5x3-k3, 4x4-k4, 6x3-k3), the two-bit scalar target adds exactly two GF(2) dimensions beyond the affine feature span.

The value-specific interaction quotient is radically smaller than the structural quadratic interaction space: target dimension 2 versus REL_INC structural rank gains 37, 295, and 472 on the three demanding carriers.

On all three demanding carriers, both the draw-indicator bit y0 and win-indicator bit y1 are individually non-affine and each contributes one rank dimension beyond the exact-rank affine component span.
Frozen REL_INC spans the complete two-bit scalar interaction target on every demanding carrier.
Fresh 3x7-k3 has six unused structural quadratic dimensions but scalar target dimension zero, confirming that structural interaction directions can exist without being value-load-bearing.

A final scalar evaluator need not expose the full quadratic interaction basis; after the affine component contribution it requires at most two independently derived GF(2) interaction syndromes on the current demanding corpus.

nonclaims: The two syndrome functions themselves are not yet identified.
The result does not imply the same two structural formulas transfer unchanged across geometries.
The result does not prove REL_INC minimality.
next_question: Which two outcome-independent structural parity functions of frozen REL_INC pair incidence realize the scalar correction bits, and can they be frozen before fresh holdout qualification?
